results.title: Risk Evaluation Result

threatRiskText.LOW: Your document structure is standard and represents complete, legally compliant property ownership.
threatRiskText.MEDIUM: Administrative or slight documentation gaps need to be regularized.
threatRiskText.HIGH: Significant legal risks identified. Transfer deeds or proper registries are missing.
threatRiskText.CRITICAL: Extremely high exposure. Ownership lacks backing of a valid sale deed or violates Supreme Court rules.
